title: Free Cancer Screening & Diagnostics Camp
summary: The Rotary Club of Mumbai Wadala East organised a Free Oral, Breast and Cervical Cancer Screening Camp at Girnar TV Room, Ivory Towers, for senior citizens and service providers.
description:
The Rotary Club of Mumbai Wadala East organised a Free Oral, Breast and Cervical Cancer Screening Camp at Girnar TV Room, Ivory Towers, for senior citizens and service providers.

The camp benefited 65 individuals, including men and women, providing free cancer screening by experienced medical professionals. Separate screening rooms ensured complete privacy and confidentiality, while lady doctors and paramedical staff provided a comfortable and supportive environment.

Free medical advice and follow-up guidance were also offered for suspected positive cases, emphasising the importance of early detection and timely treatment.

Conducted with the valuable support of SUN PHARMA, this initiative reflected the Club's commitment to accessible preventive healthcare, cancer awareness and community welfare, reinforcing the message that early detection saves lives.
location: Girnar TV room, Bhakti Park, Wadala East, Mumbai, Maharashtra
